LNG export marine terminal (2 x 225,000 m3, 2 berths, 28 MTPA)
K-7101A/B/C: 3 x 50 % centrifugal (C the installed spare), 27 t/h each, 108 -> 600 kPa(a), ~1.4 MW, electric motors 6.6 kV (D-010). Holding: one machine; loading: two.
Anti-surge recycles (DN 250): BOG-7008 to BOG-1001; BOG-7009, BOG-7012 S1 via BOG-7012 (DN 300) to BOG-1001; both upstream of the spray TV-7103. Discharges BOG-7006, BOG-7007 (DN 300).
HV-7124A/B/C normally closed (depressurising to FL-7003); XV-7125A/B/C fail open, closed only for maintenance (D-025). N2 purge connections per machine: vendor package, not drawn (D-026.9).
LZT-7106: C&E I-701. VZ-7110x: vendor unit control panel trips I-702/702B/C (vibration and bearings, dry gas seal, lube oil, motor, discharge pressure high-high).
ZSO-7121x, PZT-7113: I-705A-C stop a running machine when its suction valve XV-7121x leaves the open position or the suction header is low-low. TZT-7112x: I-703A-C.
